symptom: Every focus turned a field's border bright, including a click into it and typing, so a field shouted while the caret already showed where input goes; text inputs always match :focus-visible, so the browser cannot tell the two apart.
rule: Fields ring only when focus arrived by keyboard: focus-navigation.ts marks it data-zeros-keyboard-focus and FIELD_FOCUS in shared/ui/primitives/field.tsx reads it (docs/design-system.md §0, item 7, and §6).
